Match the same adult/slender Eula with short light-blue hair, blue-white long cape, black-white-blue knight outfit, tall dark boots, ornate long BLUE CLAYMORE with gold hilt.
NEW action: "frost descending cleave", a planted powerful OVERHEAD DOWNWARD SLASH releasing ice forward. It should be distinct from a low forward poke and from the turning dance reference. Keep largely planted feet, lift sword overhead with both hands, then cleave from very high to low forward-right with body weight.
Exactly 12 independent hand-drawn poses in four equal columns by three equal rows, read left-to-right top-to-bottom. All face right as combat direction. True transparent RGBA background. NO text, labels, numbers, grid, floor or shadows. Keep character body scale identical in all cells.
Very generous blank gutters: tiny-to-medium sprites as in image 2; a standing character head-to-boots only 45% of cell-height, combined character+sword no more than 75% of cell width and height. 1 stable ready stance, sword down-right.
2 both hands lift hilt toward chest, blade sweeps back-left and upward.
3 knees bend slightly, elbows lift, full blade rises high behind head, feet planted shoulder-width.
4 fully poised overhead, hands above head, sword extends almost vertically upward (slightly back-left), taut weight-bearing anticipation.

6 SECOND ACTIVE DESCENDING FRAME: weight settles into front leg, hands at waist level, blade tip points DOWN forward-right near shin-height. Long clean blade unmistakably downward. A small fan of three tiny ice shards just beside the sword point begins traveling right. Keep shards within frame and leave large gutter.
7 low followthrough, blade remains down-right, torso inclined, just a thin frost edge.
8 absorb sword weight through knees, tip low forward-right, cloth catches up.
9 rise slowly with blade still held low.
10 step rear foot slightly inward to recover, hilt near hip.
11 nearly upright elegant guard, cape settling.
12 return to original ready stance with blade diagonally down-right.
Require distinct weight shift/arm/leg drawings in every frame. This is a top-to-bottom chop and NOT an upward scoop, NOT a horizontal thrust. Only subtle thin icy light on 5-7; no giant VFX swirls or obscuring aura. Preserve real physical weapon outline and accurate two-handed grip.
